# Sorumatik

> > Sorumatik is a Turkish educational platform providing homework help and solutions for K5-12 math and geometry problems.

Sorumatik specializes in supporting Turkish students with detailed explanations for geometry and mathematics homework, particularly focusing on angle problems, complementary and supplementary angles, and geometric relationships. The platform offers step-by-step solutions to help students understand core mathematical concepts.

## Key Topics

- Supplementary angles
- Complementary angles
- Adjacent angles
- Geometry problems
- Angle measurement
- Turkish mathematics education
- Grade 5 (K5. Sınıf)
- Homework help
- Geometry homework
- Angle relationships
- Math questions
- Turkish math curriculum
